channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Japan and Vietnam agree to boost economic security and energy ties
item.description: Japan and Vietnam seek to strengthen economic and strategic ties amid rising regional geopolitical and trade tensions.

item.title: Man arrested over operation of rogue cellular base station in Tokyo
item.description: Chinese national Yu Hai, 31, is believed to have caused smartphones to connect to the base station through which fraudulent messages were transmitted.

item.title: Okinawa’s Koja calls for central government to explain ‘minimum’ military buildup
item.description: Okinawa Gov. Genta Koja emphasized the need to balance building up Japan's defense capabilities in the southernmost prefecture with residents' wishes.

item.title: Takaichi and LDP weigh disciplinary action for party members who abstained from food tax vote
item.description: Party leadership demanded that the lawmakers, including former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba, write statements on why they walked out of the vote.

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
